lines: +  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
+  display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; gap: 3px;
+  border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-weight: 650; font-size: 14px;
+  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 18px; align-items: flex-start;
+  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px;
+.picker label, .settings label { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
+  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
+.picker input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
+  position: absolute; z-index: 20; left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 6px);
+  margin: 0; padding: 6px; list-style: none; max-height: 320px; overflow: auto;
+  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(20, 40, 25, 0.16);
+  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left;
+  border: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink);
+.settings { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-end; border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
+.settings legend { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; padding: 0; margin-bottom: 6px; float: left; width: 100%; }
+  font: inherit; font-size: 15px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
+  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 18px;
+.summary-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 15px; }
+  font-weight: 750; font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
+.base-summary { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
+  background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn-ink); border: 1px solid var(--warn-line);
+.desktop-grid { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; overflow-x: auto; }
+  display: grid; gap: 3px; align-items: stretch; min-width: 980px;
+.header-cell { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
+.d-city-col { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 5px 7px; padding-right: 8px; }
+  border: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-weight: 750; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink);
+  background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.06em;
+.city-offset { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
+.d-action { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
+  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; color: var(--muted); width: 26px; height: 26px;
+  border-radius: 7px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
+  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 38px;
+  border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 2px 1px; text-align: center;
+.state-awake { background: var(--awake-bg); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
+.mobile-grid { display: none; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px; overflow-x: auto; }
+.m-city-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; text-align: center; padding: 4px 2px; }
+.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
+.legend > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
